title: NSA Whistle-Blower Tells All: The Program | Op-Docs | The New York Times
summary: A New York Times Op-Doc by Laura Poitras profiling William Binney, a 32-year NSA veteran who helped design a secret program he says collects Americans' personal data.
why: Cited as a primary source for Binney's claims about NSA surveillance, including the FBI raid on his home.

quote.text: William Binney describing the FBI raid on his house while he was in the shower
